author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So what is the great possession that you will return with?
context_before: People who own a fortune in diamonds often place them in a vault and never see them, yet pay insurance on them year after year – but they have the feeling of possession. So you see: regardless of how great you determine your earthly possessions to be, you cannot take them with you.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Great Possession (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then I innately knew how to get out.
context_before: I arrested this activity, the music froze, and the sustained note began to increase in volume. As its sound penetrated my very being, I awoke to find myself – not on my bed in my home, but in the holy sepulcher – my skull – where I had been throughout the centuries.
context_after: I did it and found myself surrounded by all of the imagery of scripture concerning the birth of God.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Great Possession (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So God Himself entered death’s door with we who entered.
context_before: I, who have told you what to expect, will physically disappear; but I will send the Holy Spirit, who is the Spirit of truth. He will bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you. Having proclaimed to you that I am the truth, who can I send but myself?
context_after: He lay down in the grave with us in visions of eternity, until we awake to see the linen clothes lying there that the females have woven for us.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Great Possession (1968-01-01).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-01 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Stalin thought he controlled the world.
context_before: In the meanwhile, dwell upon your great possession. If tonight you owned the earth and it vanished at your death, what would it matter?
context_after: He killed twenty million people then vanished. But Stalin did not die; he was restored to life in an environment best suited for the work yet to be done in him. Stalin is a name God adopted in order to play that part, just as God adopted the name Hitler and thought he would rule Germany.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from The Great Possession (1968-01-01).
